purpose: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE ONLY; no skill-wide scientific defaults

geometry.tolerance_note: fixture geometry audit tolerance only; not a universal numerical convergence threshold

physics.out_of_plane: Uniform across thickness; configured physical 2D thickness 0.001 m. Total W uses boundary length times thickness. No front/back loss.

physical_initial_state.reason: Steady conduction fixture has no physical transient initial state. Any default Initial Values node is initialization metadata, not an asserted physical initial condition.

solver_initial_guess.constraint: Record separately if needed; do not change physical boundary data.

physics.material_auxiliary_properties: Only constant conductivity is required by this stationary conduction problem; no invented density or heat capacity.

bnd_insulated.rule: union of bottom and top; disjoint from left/right

target_outputs.name: temperature_field
target_outputs.positions: stationary; no time/frequency/mode; fixed parameters from this case
target_outputs.required_solution: future stationary solution, owned by compute

target_outputs.name: conductive_heat_flux
target_outputs.positions: same stationary solution and fixed parameters

target_outputs.name: through_heat_rate
target_outputs.expression_definition: integral of qx over right boundary times thickness
target_outputs.statistic: outward +x flux integral, multiply thickness exactly once
target_outputs.positions: same stationary solution and fixed parameters
